Most nonzero discrepancies are consistent with Stella CSV decimal precision. The predation flow differs materially at time 41 because Stella caps the outflow of the non-negative Prey stock before the next Euler step, while PySD reports the uncapped equation value even though both trajectories reach a zero Prey stock at the next model time. This is retained as a backend-semantic limitation, not accepted through a tolerance.
